items.title: HSBC offloads $300 million troubled AI data center loan at steep discount - report
items.summary: Investing.com -- HSBC Holdings PLC (NYSE:HSBC) offloaded a roughly $300 million portion of a construction loan tied to a troubled New Mexico data center project at a steep discount, according to Bloomberg. The sale, executed at prices in the mid-80s several weeks ago, underscores mounting lender caution surrounding the financing of artificial intelligence infrastructure.
